product.title: Private Helicopter After-hours 48 Miles Tour Theme Parks&Downtown

description.text: See magical Orlando from a unique perspective in a helicopter. Get a bird’s eye view of the theme parks, the Orlando Eye, the Florida sunset, or even catch some fireworks on your sightseeing chopper tour. Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Central Florida's wildlife, coastlines, and space-coast sights. Ideal for travelers basing in Orlando who want a guided Florida experience beyond the theme parks without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
